inputs.text: [curious] Dimetrodon. "Di," in Greek, means two. [serious] "Metron," measure — like in "meter." And "odon," tooth.
[happily] Right — he had two different sizes of teeth in his mouth. He lived two hundred eighty million years ago, [amazed] in North America.
[curious] Is he a dinosaur, if he lived that long before them?
[serious] No, actually — not at all. He lived fifty million years BEFORE the first dinosaurs. [warmly] He's a very ancient cousin [confident] of furry animals, like us.
